headline: Mets, Tarik Skubal agree to 9-year, $450 million deal

top.headline: Mets, Tarik Skubal agree to 9-year, $450 million deal
top.summary: Tarik Skubal and the Mets agreed to a nine-year, $450 million contract, ESPN reported, citing sources. The deal is not yet official. The Mets' reported offer last week was nine years and $400 million, so the price went up.

top.headline: Murray, Jokic make history as Nuggets outlast Bulls in OT
top.summary: Jamal Murray scored a season-high 45, 8 of them in overtime, and Nikola Jokic had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists in Denver's 151-145 win in Chicago. NBA.com says it was the first game in league history with a triple-double on each team and 20-plus assists in one of them, courtesy of Josh Giddey's 22. Jokic's 202nd career triple-double leaves him seven behind Russell Westbrook's record.

top.headline: 49ers rout Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City
top.summary: Brock Purdy went 21-of-26 for 255 yards and three touchdowns, two to George Kittle, and San Francisco led 28-10 at halftime. Ji'Ayir Brown added a pick-six off Kirk Cousins. The 49ers are 9-1 and the Vikings fall to 7-3, but San Francisco lost RT Colton McKivitz to a fractured and dislocated left ankle.

stories.headline: Daniel Jones expected to clear waivers after Colts cut him
stories.summary: Indianapolis waived Jones a day after a 26-3 loss in Houston in which he went 12-of-27 for 144 yards and an interception. Any team that claims him takes on a contract with a $10.5 million injury guarantee, so he is expected to clear Monday afternoon and become a free agent. Anthony Richardson Sr. now starts for the Colts.

stories.headline: Cowboys score on every real possession in 51-30 win over Titans
stories.summary: Dallas scored touchdowns on its first six drives and scored on every possession except a closing kneel-down. CeeDee Lamb became the first Cowboys receiver with six straight 1,000-yard seasons. Dallas is 5-6; Tennessee is 1-9.

stories.headline: Eagles beat Steelers 19-16 with Joe Milton at QB; DK Metcalf ejected
stories.summary: With backup Joe Milton starting, Philadelphia sacked Aaron Rodgers five times and Saquon Barkley broke a 38-yard touchdown run. Metcalf was ejected in the second half for unsportsmanlike conduct and finished with one catch for 2 yards. Pittsburgh has lost 12 straight in Philadelphia.

stories.headline: Panthers edge Ravens 35-33 to take hold of NFC South
stories.summary: Ryan Fitzgerald's 37-yard field goal with 1:44 left settled a game with seven lead changes, and Tyrel Dodson intercepted Jacoby Brissett to end it. Carolina is 5-5 and two games clear of three 3-7 division rivals. Baltimore is 4-7 without Lamar Jackson (thumb).

standouts.name: Brock Purdy
standouts.note: Put up 28 first-half points on Minnesota and sat midway through the fourth quarter.

standouts.name: Jared Goff
standouts.note: Went 4-of-4 on deep throws for 145 yards and both scores in Detroit's first game without Aidan Hutchinson.

standouts.name: Travis Kelce
standouts.note: His first multi-TD game in 47 games moved him to third all-time with 110 tight end touchdowns, counting playoffs.

moves.text: Colts waived QB Daniel Jones; expected to clear waivers Monday afternoon, no claim reported
Eagles placed Zack Baun and Dontayvion Wicks on injured reserve
Cowboys placed DaRon Bland on injured reserve
Titans placed Tyjae Spears on IR; Panthers placed Isaiah Simmons on IR

stories.headline: Heat win seventh straight as Giannis and SGA both sit
stories.summary: Miami beat Oklahoma City 123-113 for its seventh win in a row, with Giannis Antetokounmpo (right groin) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (neck strain, lower back contusion) both out. It was the first game each had missed this season. Bam Adebayo had 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists.

stories.headline: Thunder down to nine players as injury list grows
stories.summary: Oklahoma City had nine players available in Miami, three of them on two-way contracts. Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso were among those out. The Thunder are 10-7, and Gilgeous-Alexander's status for Monday at Indiana is uncertain.

standouts.name: Jamal Murray
standouts.note: Season high, including 8 in overtime, in the win at Chicago.

standouts.name: Nikola Jokic
standouts.note: His 202nd career triple-double, seven short of Westbrook's record.

standouts.name: Josh Giddey
standouts.note: Career-high 22 assists in the overtime loss.

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Bedard needs shoulder surgery; Blues rally from 4-1 down in the third to beat the Oilers

stories.headline: Bedard to have shoulder surgery
stories.summary: Blackhawks GM Kyle Davidson said Connor Bedard will have surgery on the right shoulder he hurt on a faceoff against the Maple Leafs on Tuesday. No timeline has been given. It is his third shoulder injury in less than a year.

stories.headline: Blues erase 3-goal third-period deficit, beat Oilers in shootout
stories.summary: Edmonton led 4-1 in the third before St. Louis scored three times, the last two 26 seconds apart from Pavel Buchnevich and Jimmy Snuggerud. Jake Neighbours and Mason McTavish scored in the shootout for a fourth straight win. The Oilers have lost three straight despite Leon Draisaitl reaching 1,100 career points.

stories.headline: Hurricanes first to 100 goals, extend point streak to seven
stories.summary: Carolina beat the Rangers 5-2 at MSG to move to 18-3-3, with 12 skaters registering a point. The Hurricanes have outshot their opponent in 23 straight games, the longest such streak on record.

stories.headline: MacKinnon now expected to miss about 12 weeks
stories.summary: After a reevaluation of Nathan MacKinnon's lower-body injury, Avalanche coach Jared Bednar expects him out about 12 weeks, up from the original one-month estimate. He will likely miss the Dec. 31 Winter Classic against Utah.

standouts.name: Roman Kantserov
standouts.note: Hat trick in Chicago's 6-3 win in Vancouver.

standouts.name: Jake Oettinger
standouts.note: Shut out Pittsburgh in the night's only 1-0 game.

standouts.name: Tage Thompson
standouts.note: Scored twice in the second period, one on the power play, as Buffalo pulled away in Tampa.
